== Summary ==
Errata sheet slip, 17 September 2007: •Tusken Breath Mask (V), as printed on the Players Committee's errata sheet “Errata: September 17, 2007” for [[Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court]]. The Committee's re-edited set sheet for the same errata (VirtualCards8.pdf) prints different wording: “…your total ability during battle at a site is +X.” instead of “…may add X to your total ability during battle at a site.”

Source: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071026144228/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/Errata9_17.pdf Errata9_17.pdf] (swccgpc.com, “Errata: September 17, 2007”, PDF dated 14 September 2007; Internet Archive capture 26 October 2007), page 1, slip 22. The PDF page was rendered at 200 dpi and the slip cut out; nothing else was changed.

Used on: [[Tusken Breath Mask (V) (Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court) (PC Errata 2007)|Tusken Breath Mask (V) (Virtual Set 8) (PC Errata 2007)]].
